limitations: Requires the S7 fixture to be imported into the two supplied isolated shops before running.
The default run scans all 1,000 imported ASINs with a maximum of 10 concurrent scan workers.
Queue backlog is the maximum local-database count of queued, running, and retry_wait jobs sampled once per second.
Index build time is measured during import and is not inferred from scan timing.
Server CPU and memory are reported only when an explicit loopback stats endpoint provides them.
A local API run does not constitute target-environment or production capacity acceptance.
